signals.summary: Le Rwanda avait rompu ses relations avec la Belgique le 17 mars 2025 après l’avoir accusée d’avoir pris le parti de Kinshasa dans le conflit à l’est de la RDC. Les deux pays privilégient désormais le dialogue.

signals.title: Maroc : le géant OCP poursuit sa réorganisation dans un contexte de chocs géopolitiques
signals.summary: Quelques mois après sa réorganisation d’avril, OCP procède à de nouveaux ajustements à sa tête. Hicham El Habti hérite notamment du poste de secrétaire général. Coulisses.

signals.title: Bridge Bank to Start Trading On BRVM Sept 24 After Oversubscribed IPO
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Bridge Bank Group Côte d'Ivoire will begin trading on the BRVM on September 24 after its public share sale attracted CFAF 95.8 billion of orders for CFAF 67.5 billion of stock. The shares will trade under the ticker BBGC with a reference price of CFAF 6,750.

signals.title: Morocco’s opposition leader casts vote in parliamentary election
signals.summary: The leader of Morocco's opposition PPS (Party of Progress and Socialism) arrived at a polling station in Rabat on Wednesday to vote in the parliamentary election.

signals.title: RDC : face à Félix Tshisekedi, l’opposition est-elle en train de perdre la bataille de la rue ?
signals.summary: Malgré le faible engouement suscité par sa marche du 15 septembre, la coalition C64 mise toujours sur la mobilisation populaire pour contrer le projet de changement constitutionnel. Mais sa capacité à imposer un rapport de force avec le pouvoir semble pour l’instant limitée.

signals.title: WELCOME BACK: Great white shark spotted in False Bay after eight-year absence
signals.summary: Bold as brass, a lone great white shark made a big splash off the coast of Cape Town on Wednesday, September 23, becoming the first of its species to be sighted and filmed in False Bay in nearly eight years. These sharks disappeared from False Bay, largely because of predation by killer whales with an appetite for shark livers.

signals.title: « Le choix du Togo…est d’aider les pays de l’AES », Robert Dussey
signals.summary: Le ministre togolais des Affaires étrangères, Robert Dussey, appelle à ne pas isoler les pays de l'Alliance des États du Sahel. Il a accordé un entretien à France 24 en marge de l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU à New York.

signals.title: Vodacom-Safaricom : plongée au cœur des controverses entourant la vente du fleuron kényan
signals.summary: La Haute Cour du Kenya a annulé la vente d’une participation de 15 % dans Safaricom à Vodacom, jugeant le processus inconstitutionnel. Un verdict qui relance le débat sur la transparence et le prix de la cession.

signals.title: Gayton Mckenzie Promises Debt Write-Offs, 'Abahambe' Crackdown in Nelson Mandela Bay
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] With the 2026 local elections approaching, PA leader Gayton McKenzie says voters should give his party five years to govern Nelson Mandela Bay, promising a fresh approach to the metro's debt, jobs, services and immigration.

signals.title: Gabon: le gouvernement radie plus de 1000 employés absents de la fonction publique
signals.summary: Au Gabon, c’est une grande première dans l’administration publique. Vendredi 18 septembre, le conseil des ministres réuni à Port-Gentil, la capitale économique, a décidé de radier 1 473 agents de la fonction publique. La plupart d'entre eux ne s'étaient pas présentés à leur poste depuis des mois, voire des années, et vivaient à l'étranger.

signals.title: Ethiopia: Tigray forces seize airports as fighting spreads to Afar
signals.summary: Tigrayan rebels in northern Ethiopia seized control of airports and battled federal troops in the neighbouring Afar region, multiple sources told AFP on Wednesday, as long-standing tensions spilled into open conflict.

signals.title: Nigeria : TotalEnergies mise 800 millions de dollars sur le champ gazier d’Ima
signals.summary: Le géant pétrolier français a acté sa décision d’investir massivement dans un champ gazier inexploité depuis sa découverte au large de l’île de Bonny il y a près de cinquante ans. Un signal fort pour Bola Tinubu, qui veut faire du pays un hub énergétique continental.

signals.title: Tanzanian opposition leader urges courageous verdict in treason trial
signals.summary: Chadema leader, Tundu Lissu, has pleaded not guilty saying the charges were politically motivated.

signals.title: Tribunal Penal Internacional considera ex-comandante rebelde da RCA culpado de crimes contra a humanidade
signals.summary: O Tribunal Penal Internacional considerou um antigo comandante rebelde da República Centro-Africana culpado de crimes contra a humanidade em 2013, quando o país mergulhava numa guerra civil.

signals.title: Mulwa Family to Take Plea in Dr Victoria Mutiso Murder Case Next Week
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Rose Mbithe Mulwa and her two children, Angela Mulwa and Chris Mulwa, will on September 29 appear before the High Court in Nairobi to formally take plea in the murder case arising from the killing of psychiatrist Dr Victoria Nthunya Mutiso.

signals.title: Raila's Brother Hits Back At Uhuru Over 2022 Election Claim
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The family of the late former Prime Minister Raila Odinga has hit back at retired President Uhuru Kenyatta after he renewed his claim that Raila won the 2022 presidential election.

signals.title: What South Africa's Major Parties Are Promising Voters in the 2026 Local Elections
signals.summary: [Africa Check] What South Africa's major parties are promising voters in the 2026 local elections

signals.title: Madagascar : Le procès sur la vente des Boeing 777 à l’Iran renvoyé au 27 octobre
signals.summary: Le procès de 33 prévenus dans l’affaire des cinq Boeing 777 retrouvés en Iran a été renvoyé au 27 octobre par la justice malgache. Un an après leur découverte, les accusés sont poursuivis notamment pour faux et usage de faux ainsi que pour atteinte à la souveraineté nationale.

signals.title: ICC convicts former CAR militia commander of crimes against humanity
signals.summary: The International Criminal Court on Wednesday found rebel commander Mahamat Said Abdel Kani guilty of abusing and torturing prisoners while running a detention facility in the Central African Republic.

signals.title: Ouganda : la reforestation au secours des gorilles des montagnes
signals.summary: Dans le sud-ouest de l’Ouganda, des communautés locales se mobilisent pour restaurer les forêts autour du parc national de la Forêt impénétrable de Bwindi et préserver l’habitat des gorilles des montagnes.

signals.title: Les relations avec Paris "n'ont jamais été difficiles", dit le chef de la diplomatie togolaise
signals.summary: Dans un entretien accordé à France 24 en marge de l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU à New York, le ministre togolais des Affaires étrangères, Robert Dussey, assure que les relations "n'ont jamais été difficiles" entre la France et le Togo, pays où France 24 et RFI sont suspendus. Il appelle aussi à ne pas isoler les pays de l'Alliance des États du Sahel.

signals.title: Watch: Why is the UK reviewing its Chagos Islands deal?
signals.summary: The UK is reviewing its deal to hand over the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, the defence secretary has said.

signals.title: ONU : Diomaye Faye rencontre Emmanuel Macron à New-York
signals.summary: En marge de l'Assemblée générale de l'ONU à New York, les présidents Bassirou Diomaye Faye et Emmanuel Macron se sont entretenus ce mardi à New York, en présence de l'ancien président sénégalais, et de la délégation française.

signals.title: CRICKET FEAST: Proteas’ David Miller pumped for exciting home summer as World Cup nears
signals.summary: The Proteas begin their busiest home summer of cricket in nearly a decade with a 50-over series against Australia. Later on in the year, South Africa will also host Bangladesh and England in multi-format series.

signals.title: Morocco votes in parliamentary election amid youth discontent
signals.summary: Moroccans are voting today in parliamentary elections dominated by concerns over the cost of living, jobs and inequality, with many voters also expressing deep distrust of political parties.

signals.title: Why Tigray’s airport takeover could reignite Ethiopia’s civil war
signals.summary: Tigrayan forces in Ethiopia have seized Mekelle airport just days after former battlefield enemies joined forces against Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government.

signals.title: Ruto's UNGA Deals - Jobs, Ai, Trade and Sh600bn Investment for Kenya
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto's engagements at the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York are beginning to translate into a series of investment, technology, trade and security opportunities for Kenya.

signals.title: Archbishop of Nampula to Catholic University Graduates - 'Science Without Conscience Is Simply the Ruin of the Soul'
signals.summary: [Agenzia Fides] Nampula -- "Seeing young people who are well-educated and full of hope facing an uncertain future, precisely at a time when the country needs their skills, energy and talent most, is one of the most painful realities afflicting our beloved land."

signals.title: Angola: greve na educação gera denúncias de agressões e cortes salariais
signals.summary: Em Angola, o Sindicato Nacional de Professores (SINPROF) denuncia alegados actos de intimidação, ameaças de cortes salariais e agressões contra docentes que aderiram à greve do ensino geral, iniciada há três dias em todo o país. A organização sindical acusa alguns responsáveis de recorrerem à pressão para tentar travar as reivindicações dos professores.

signals.title: Guinée : Cellou Dalein Diallo déplore la révocation de son passeport
signals.summary: L’opposant guinéen Cellou Dalein Diallo affirme que son passeport a été révoqué par les autorités, l’empêchant de se rendre à New York pour participer à des réunions en marge de l’Assemblée générale des Nations unies.

signals.title: Ethiopie : « Alliance pour la survie », nouvelle coalition armée hostile au gouvernement
signals.summary: En Éthiopie, sept groupes armés issus de plusieurs régions du pays ont formé une coalition à l'appel d'un chef rebelle. Ils se fixent pour objectif de renverser le Premier ministre Abiy Ahmed et de mettre en place un gouvernement de transition.

signals.title: RDC : enquête judiciaire après les incidents lors de la marche de la C64
signals.summary: Le ministre de la Justice a ordonné l’ouverture d’une enquête judiciaire sur les violences et incidents rapportés lors des manifestations de l’opposition du mardi 15 septembre à Kinshasa ainsi que dans  d’autres villes et localités du pays.

signals.title: Ruto Unveils $600m Clean Cooking Investment Opportunity, Nairobi to Host 2027 Africa Summit
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto has co-hosted a high-level clean cooking event with Norway on the sidelines of the 81st United Nations General Assembly in New York, where Kenya presented a $600 million investment opportunity in clean cooking and confirmed Nairobi as the venue for the Second Africa Clean Cooking Summit in January 2027.

signals.title: Mali – États-Unis : pourquoi le soutien de l’Ukraine au FLA contrarie l’administration Trump
signals.summary: Des opérateurs de drones ukrainiens apportent un soutien actif aux indépendantistes du FLA et à leurs alliés du Jnim contre Assimi Goïta. Une révélation embarrassante pour Washington, théoriquement proche de Kiev mais désireux de renouer avec Bamako.

signals.title: Spaza Shops in the Spotlight As New Rules Loom
signals.summary: [Scrolla] The National Consumer Commission has published draft guidelines aimed at spaza shops and informal traders, and wants public comment within 45 days.   Inspections found most informal traders checked were breaking consumer protection rules, including not showing prices properly and misleading customers.

signals.title: FEMINIST HISTORY: Pacifist Emily Hobhouse’s 1926 state funeral to be brought back to life in Bloemfontein
signals.summary: A century after the state funeral of British pacifist, feminist and humanitarian, Emily Hobhouse, in Bloemfontein, the Emily100 movement is planning to re-enact the event. The recreation, taking place on 31 October 2026, will bring new life to Hobhouse’s story and connect younger generations to an important chapter in South Africa’s history.

signals.title: Somalia, Morocco Foreign Ministers Meet in New York to Strengthen Ties
signals.summary: [Shabelle] New York -- Somali Foreign Minister Abdisalam Abdi Ali met his Moroccan counterpart Nasser Bourita in New York on the sidelines of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, discussing ways to strengthen bilateral relations and cooperation.

signals.title: RDC : Baraka Kabemba, le consultant qui veut doper les revenus de la Gécamines
signals.summary: Ancien associé d’EY et familier des partenariats miniers de la Gécamines, Baraka Kabemba a pris les commandes de l’entreprise publique en mars 2026 avec l’objectif de mieux valoriser ses actifs.

signals.title: U.S. to Disburse 1.5 Million Dollars for Weapons Control
signals.summary: [AIM] Maputo -- The United States government has pledged to disburse 1.5 million dollars to strengthen Mozambique's management of weapons and ammunition, as part of a program aimed at strengthening security in the country.

signals.title: Xenophobic Surge Dials Up Trauma for Many Immigrant Pupils At SA Schools in 2026
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] XenoBarometer tracks the anti-immigrant movement and its impact. We aim to surface underreported stories, paying close attention to potential rights abuses, emerging patterns in anti-immigrant mobilisation and failures in the government's response.

signals.title: Death Penalty - Let's Not Aspire to Being a Bloodthirsty, Barbaric Nation
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] As ANC leaders revive calls to restore the death penalty, evidence shows capital punishment neither deters crime nor protects survivors from wrongful convictions.

signals.title: GROOT BOEREWORS TREK: Succulent & spicy — the very best boerie in the land
signals.summary: After traversing South Africa in search of the very best that a stukkie boerewors can be, the wagons have come in, delivering a load of wors from every corner of the land. And we have a decisive winner.

signals.title: Idio Chichava transforma o ruído de Maputo em dança em Paris
signals.summary: O ruído de um mercado de Maputo chegou este fim-de-semana, 19 e 20 de Setembro, à Cité du Cinéma, em Saint-Denis, nos arredores de Paris. Na inauguração do novo espaço cultural, o coreógrafo moçambicano Idio Chichava apresentou We Gather in the Embers of the Noise That Burns, uma criação onde corpos e vozes transformam a agitação diária em memória, resistência e celebração.

signals.title: JUSTICE DENIED: Honoured in Constantia, reviled in Liberia — fugitive war criminal Guus Kouwenhoven dies free
signals.summary: Dutch war criminal Guus Kouwenhoven recently died. Some honoured his life at a church service in Cape Town, where he lived opulently while fighting extradition to the Netherlands.

signals.title: JOJ 2026 au Sénégal: «Vous devenez des acteurs des Jeux», le maire de Dakar mobilise les volontaires
signals.summary: Dernière ligne droite pour le comité d’organisation des Jeux olympiques de la jeunesse qui se dérouleront à Dakar du 31 octobre au 13 novembre. La mairie de la ville de Dakar a réuni, mardi 22 septembre 2026, près de 300 volontaires pour accompagner les organisateurs.

signals.title: Ceuta : contrôles renforcés à la frontière face à la menace d'une crise migratoire
signals.summary: Le gouvernement espagnol veut s'assurer qu'aucun migrant en situation irrégulière ne puisse atteindre Ceuta, dans un contexte d'élections au Maroc.

signals.title: The Deportation Project : "Nous les accueillons, sauf les criminels", dit le président burundais
signals.summary: Le président burundais s'est exprimé sur l'enquête d'un consortium de médias internationaux, dont FRANCE 24, consacrée aux accords passés entre plusieurs pays africains et l'administration Trump pour accueillir des personnes expulsées de pays tiers. Le Burundi en a récemment accueilli une douzaine. "Le Burundi est un pays d'accueil", justifie Evariste Ndayishimiye, précisant que son gouvernement a seulement demandé aux États-Unis de ne pas "amener des criminels".

signals.title: Uganda community plants trees to protect mountain gorillas
signals.summary: About 450 mountain gorillas live in Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in south-western Uganda. The apes are threatened by deforestation, but local communities are working to protect their habitat by planting trees, in the hope of reducing pressure on the forest.

signals.title: Nigerian football enduring 'worst time in history' - Odegbami
signals.summary: Former Afcon winner Segun Odegbami has slammed those running Nigerian football after the country missed out on the men's and women's World Cups.

signals.title: SPOTLIGHT: Health policy trailblazer Precious Matsoso credits patience, faith and The Beatles
signals.summary: Precious Matsoso tells Spotlight how, over three decades, she helped shape some of the most consequential health policy negotiations in South Africa and in global governance. She also shares memories about her Soweto childhood filled with music, science and political uprisings.

signals.title: Senators Clash Over Seven CSs Accompanying Ruto to UNGA
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Ruling coalition and opposition senators clashed on Wednesday over the decision by seven Cabinet Secretaries to accompany President William Ruto to the United Nations General Assembly in New York.

signals.title: Number of ATMs Falls Amid Shift to Digital Banking
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The number of Automated Teller Machines (ATMs) in Kenya fell by 2.66 percent to 2,228 in 2025 as banks and customers increasingly shifted to mobile and digital banking.

signals.title: The Continuation of Femicide in SA Is a Societal Failure
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] A woman goes out for a run, not to provoke, not to challenge, not to invite danger, but simply to enjoy the freedom of movement, exercise, and relaxation that should belong to every human being. Yet for many women, even the simplest act of jogging carries an unspoken calculation of risk. One has to first negotiate in her mind: Which route is safest? What time is too late? Who should know where I am? Will I make it home? The tragedy is not that women ask…

signals.title: Over 2.5 Million Angolans Update Voter Registration Data
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Malanje -- At least 2.5 million Angolan citizens aged 18 and over across the country have already updated their data as part of the Official Voter Registration process, which has been under way since June.

signals.title: Au Niger, l’avocat et activiste Abdourahamane Lirwana écroué après avoir évoqué les dissensions au sein de l’armée
signals.summary: Figure de la société civile nigérienne, Abdourahamane Lirwana a été incarcéré mardi à la prison civile de Niamey pour « diffusion de données de nature à troubler l’ordre public », après des publications sur les réseaux sociaux.

signals.title: Législatives au Maroc : seulement 4 % des votants sont des jeunes
signals.summary: Les Marocains sont appelés aux urnes, mercredi, pour élire les 395 députés de la Chambre des représentants. Un scrutin à forts enjeux, notamment pour une jeunesse confrontée au chômage et aux difficultés d'accès aux services publics. Mais dans une monarchie où le roi conserve d'importantes prérogatives, quelle marge de manœuvre auront réellement les élus ?

signals.title: Élections au Maroc : un test pour la confiance des jeunes en la politique
signals.summary: Les élections législatives au Maroc constituent un test pour le système politique, confronté à une jeunesse de plus en plus désenchantée et dont une partie affirme ne plus croire aux promesses des partis.

signals.title: Cameroun : comment Louis-Paul Motaze prépare le terrain en vue d’un accord avec le FMI
signals.summary: Nouveau programme avec le FMI, emprunt obligataire, roadshow à Londres : Yaoundé cherche des financements sur tous les fronts. Mais les conditions posées par le Fonds restent loin d’être toutes remplies.

signals.title: Nigerian officials linked to millions laundered through US property, report
signals.summary: A report by an African anti-corruption group alleges that dozens of Nigerian officials laundered hundreds of millions of dollars through property purchases in the United States over more than two decades.

signals.title: Caf flags accommodation, visa gaps ahead of Afcon 2027
signals.summary: A delegation met Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni and shared the concerns.

signals.title: Cameroun : la « bamiphobie », un débat qui continue de déchirer le pays
signals.summary: Au Cameroun, le débat sur la « bamiphobie », un terme popularisé par l’écrivain Patrice Nganang et qui désigne la discrimination des Bamilékés, continue de faire rage. L’opposant Alain Fogué l’a relancé depuis sa cellule de la prison de Kondengui.

signals.title: Morocco Goes to Polls With Youth Unemployment Topping Voter Concerns
signals.summary: [RFI] Moroccans will on Wednesday elect a new parliament, with the political disengagement of the country's youth among the main issues shaping the vote.

signals.title: Bienal de Luanda quer mostrar potencial da água para "aproximar" povos em África
signals.summary: A água é vida, mas é também a origem de muitos conflitos entre diferentes povos ao longo da História. A Bienal de Luanda, que decorre este ano nos dias 22 e 23 de Outubro na capital angolana, quer mostrar as potencialidades da água para aproximar os povos e não para os afastar, tornando-a uma fonte de prevenção de conflitos, como explicou à RFI Ana Elisa Santana Afonso, que lidera este encontro de alto nível apoiado pela UNESCO.

signals.title: There's No Conspiracy in the Sahel - - There's a Gap, and Bamako Knows How to Use It
signals.summary: [African Arguments] A familiar claim keeps surfacing in the rhetoric of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger's ruling juntas, echoed enthusiastically by Russian state media: the West is deliberately working to destabilise the Sahel's military governments. It's a tidy story. It bundles sanctions, frozen aid and diplomatic isolation into a single narrative of conspiracy. But look closely at who is actually doing what, and what looks like a strategy of destabilisation turns out to…

signals.title: Elections 2026 | Is Your Municipality Keeping You Healthy?
signals.summary: [Health-e] 47% of municipal wastewater systems are in a critical state. Local services can shape the health of entire communities. Health-e News' CJ's will investigate failures across South Africa.

signals.title: In Tanzania, the Sea Is Moving Inland - and Taking Livelihoods With It
signals.summary: [UN News] Along the coast of Tanzania, in East Africa, the Indian Ocean is pushing saltwater ever farther inland, shrinking coconut harvests, driving fish away and leaving some residents wondering how much longer they can stay.

signals.title: Who, CJID Convene African Editors to Develop Road Safety Reporting Guidelines
signals.summary: [CJID] Abuja -- Three-day forum brings editors and journalists from five African countries together around evidence, reporting practice and safer-road policy.

signals.title: How Gauteng's New Panic App Exposed Your Data
signals.summary: [GroundUp] Reports about domestic violence and assault, including images and locations, could be accessed by a tech-savvy computer user

signals.title: Au Sénégal, Bassirou Diomaye Faye, un président confronté à un procès en « trahison »
signals.summary: Depuis sa rupture avec son Premier ministre, Ousmane Sonko, dont il avait été le bras droit, le chef de l’État sénégalais est sous le feu des critiques de ses anciens alliés Pastef. Après avoir conquis le pouvoir ensemble, les deux ex-partenaires en appellent désormais au verdict des urnes.

signals.title: 'I expect nothing': Morocco elections test young people's faith in politics
signals.summary: As Morocco goes to the vote on Wednesday, the parliamentary elections are being closely watched as a test of citizens’ faith in the political process. The vote comes as the country marks one year since youth-led demonstrations swept the nation, calling for jobs and better public services.

signals.title: Les Marocains ont voté pour des législatives sans grand favori
signals.summary: Le Maroc a organisé, mercredi, des élections législatives après une campagne dominée par les préoccupations liées au pouvoir d'achat, à l'emploi et aux inégalités, dans un contexte de défiance envers les partis politiques. Le taux de participation, en particulier chez les jeunes, sera l'un des tests majeurs de ce scrutin.

signals.title: Jkci Expansion to Boost Tanzania's Cardiac Hub Ambition
signals.summary: [Daily News] Dar es Salaam -- Tanzania is strengthening its position as a regional hub for advanced cardiac treatment and surgery following the signing of a 112bn/- agreement with China to expand the Jakaya Kikwete Cardiac Institute (JKCI) at Mloganzila.

signals.title: PM Pledges Stronger Government-Religious Ties
signals.summary: [Daily News] Dar es Salaam -- Prime Minister Dr Mwigulu Nchemba has assured religious institutions of continued government cooperation in promoting social cohesion, strengthening moral values and improving the welfare of Tanzanians.

signals.title: 'Embrace Union Spirit'
signals.summary: [Daily News] Zanzibar -- Vice-president Deogratius Ndejembi has urged Union institutions to strengthen cooperation, utilise available opportunities and jointly participate in activities both within and outside the country to enhance efficiency and deliver greater benefits to Tanzanians.

signals.title: Angola Elected Atomic Energy Agency Board Member
signals.summary: [ANGOP] Luanda -- Angola has been elected, to a rotating mandate, on the Board of Governors of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) for the 2026-2028 period.

signals.title: RD Congo : le parti UDPS fait une démonstration de force à Kinshasa
signals.summary: En RD Congo, les militants de la majorité au pouvoir ont défilé en masse pour soutenir le président Félix Tshisekedi. Une mobilisation organisée une semaine après celle de l’opposition. Objectif affiché : montrer le soutien du camp présidentiel au projet de changement de Constitution.

signals.title: How Ceuta, football and Israel are shaping Morocco's election
signals.summary: Young voters are being courted with football slogans, promises of jobs and anti-Israel rallying calls.

signals.title: Europe’s political centre is almost out of time
signals.summary: Europe’s political centre is fracturing as economic stagnation fuels the far right, threatening Germany, the rules-based order and South Africa.

signals.title: Noma: The neglected disease devastating children in northern Nigeria
signals.summary: Noma is a rapidly progressing and often fatal infection of the face and mouth. It begins with gum inflammation in malnourished children living in polluted environments and quickly spreads to destroy soft tissues and bones. It mostly affects 2- to 6-year-old children, especially in poor communities.

signals.title: ONU : comment Macky Sall a tenté d’empêcher l’accès à un site web critiquant son bilan
signals.summary: Le 9 septembre, le tribunal judiciaire de Paris a débouté l’ancien président du Sénégal, qui tentait de faire bloquer l’accès, depuis la France, à un site militant qui entend démontrer son « inaptitude » à la fonction de secrétaire général des Nations unies.

signals.title: Djibouti Frees Top SA Investigative Journalist Micah Reddy
signals.summary: [Daily Maverick] South African investigative journalist Micah Reddy of the International Consortium of Investigative Journalists was detained on Saturday, but is now on his way back to South Africa.

signals.title: Élections au Maroc : au-delà des promesses, les défis économiques du prochain gouvernement
signals.summary: Au Maroc, la campagne législative se joue sur le terrain social. SMIG à 5 000 dirhams, revalorisation des retraites, création d’emplois : les partis surenchérissent face à des défis économiques qui dépassent les slogans.

signals.title: 'I have never felt heat like that' - a survivor on watching 33 cellmates die in Nigeria
signals.summary: The BBC goes inside the prison where prisoners were trapped in stifling, cramped conditions.

signals.title: Ceuta on alert as Spain braces for new border surge
signals.summary:
Ceuta is on alert. Spanish forces are patrolling the border after fresh calls on social media for migrants to cross from Morocco.
The warnings follow a dramatic crisis on July 30 and 31, when more than 70,000 people entered the Spanish territory by swimming around the border fence.

signals.title: Serengeti Balloon Safaris Becomes World's First B Corp-Certified Balloon Company
signals.summary: [Daily News] Serengeti -- SERENGETI Balloon Safaris has become the world's first hot-air balloon company to achieve Certified B Corporation status, giving the Tanzanian tourism operator an internationally recognised benchmark for its environmental, social and governance practices.

signals.title: Dr Samia to Meet African Leaders in Talks to Bolster Investment in Reproductive, Maternal, Child Healthcare
